title: Ravens place Nnamdi Madubuike, Travis Jones and others on PUP list

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ravens place Nnamdi Madubuike, Travis Jones and others on PUP list
sources.description: On Saturday evening, the Ravens officially placed defensive lineman Nnamdi Madubuike on the Physically Unable to Perform (PUP) list, as reported by The Athletic’s Jeff Zrebeic. In addition to Madbuike, they also placed several other players on the PUP list: DT Travis Jones, ILB Teddye Buchanan, CB Bilhal Kone, DT John Jenkins, and OLB Adisa […]
